question: As of 2022, which among of the following is the leading tidal energy generation site of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gulf of Kutch**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Gulf of Kutch** is the leading tidal energy generation site in India as of 2022.
 
• It is located on the west coast of India, in the state of Gujarat.
 
• The region is known for its high tidal range, making it suitable for tidal energy projects.
